title: Count of Segments in a String

notes: A segment is a contiguous sequence of non-space characters.
A new segment starts at index 0 or immediately after a space.
constraints: s consists of lowercase and uppercase English letters, digits, or one of the following characters "!@#$%^&*()_+-=',.:".
The only space character in s is ' '.
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]
content.problemStatement:
With a string `s`, output *the number of segments in the string*.

A **segment** is defined to be a contiguous sequence of **non-space characters**.

**Example 1:**

```
Input: s = "Hello, my name is Aditya"
Output: 5
Explanation: The five segments are ["Hello,", "my", "name", "is", "Aditya"]
```

**Example 2:**

```
Input: s = "Hello"
Output: 1
```

**Constraints:**

* `0 <= s.length <= 300`
* `s` is composed of lowercase and uppercase English letters, digits, or one of the following characters `"!@#$%^&*()_+-=',.:"`.
* The only space character in `s` is `' '`.

notes: Expected output is the JSON-serialised integer returned by countSegments.
Only the literal space character separates segments.
solution.approach: Scan the string once and count each segment start.

better.complexity: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
better.description: Scan while tracking whether the previous character was a space.

optimal.complexity: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
optimal.description: Count a segment when the current character is non-space and either it is the first character or the previous character is a space.

bruteForce.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) extra space.
bruteForce.description: Split on spaces, discard empty pieces, and count the remaining pieces.

code.C:
#include <stdio.h>
int countSegments(char*s){int a=0,in=0;for(int i=0;s[i];i++){if(s[i]!=' '){if(!in){a++;in=1;}}else in=0;}return a;}
code.C++: class Solution{public:int countSegments(string s){int a=0;bool in=false;for(char c:s){if(c!=' '){if(!in){a++;in=true;}}else in=false;}return a;}};
code.Java: class Solution { public int countSegments(String s){ int a=0; boolean in=false; for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++){ char c=s.charAt(i); if(c!=' '){ if(!in){a++; in=true;} } else in=false; } return a; } }
